models.name: PeKwawu v2 (Long Residual Limb)
models.description: Fully procedural parametric prosthetic arm for long forearm residual limbs. All geometry is computed from code — no STL imports, renders completely in the browser. Palm breadth drives the master scale, residual limb length and circumference size the forearm socket, and structural frame rods bridge socket to hand. Assembled view shows full arm with fingers; toggle show_assembled off to see the socket and palm separately.

parameters.name: palm_breadth_mm
parameters.caption: Palm breadth / knuckle width — master scale driver (mm)

parameters.name: residual_length_mm
parameters.caption: Residual limb length — elbow crease to wrist attachment (mm)

parameters.name: residual_circumference_proximal_mm
parameters.caption: Forearm circumference just below elbow crease (mm)

parameters.name: padding_thickness_mm
parameters.caption: Inner padding thickness added to socket bore (mm)

parameters.name: pivot_diameter_mm
parameters.caption: Hinge pin diameter — all joints use the same pin (mm)

parameters.name: strap_width_mm
parameters.caption: Velcro strap width — drives socket slot size (mm)

parameters.name: show_assembled
parameters.caption: Show full assembly with fingers (false = socket + palm only)
